parts.text:
(a) Find the binomial series expansion of
$\sqrt{4-9x}, \ |x|<\frac{4}{9}$
in ascending powers of $x$, up to and including the term in $x^2$
Give each coefficient in its simplest form.
(5)

$=2\left[1-\frac{9}{8}x-\frac{81}{128}x^2+...\right]$
$=2-\frac{9}{4}x;-\frac{81}{64}x^2+...$: A1 for $2-\frac{9}{4}x$ (simplified fractions) or allow $2-2.25x$ or $2-2\frac{1}{4}x$; A1 for accept only $-\frac{81}{64}x^2$ or $-1\frac{17}{64}x^2$ or $-1.265625x^2$, isw
